name: Distribution-group observations (selected groups)
description: Selected Exchange group configuration and direct members. Raw owner/member identities and per-value states; no recursion, effective delivery or name joins.

parameters.name: GroupGuids
parameters.label: Exchange group GUIDs
parameters.help: One to50 exact Exchange group GUIDs separated by commas. No names, SMTP addresses, recursive expansion or implicit estate scan.

prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later and recipient read access. Role names and module output remain live-unverified; the toolkit installs nothing.
limitations: Experimental/default-off read-only Run. Explicit selected group GUIDs, verified tenant/account, supported installed Exchange module/runtime and exact review required.

At most50targets,5,000 raw owner/member observations including target diagnostics,100calls,100values per list,300seconds and32MiB output. Failed/unattempted reads never become zero members or complete deployment evidence.

Direct distribution/security-group and room-list membership only. Dynamic/Microsoft365 groups, recursion, name resolution and effective delivery/access are unsupported. Original source IDs and Entra directory IDs remain separate.
